pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: PRODUCTION - PD-4721 fired: inference-queue-depth > 95% for 10m. Service: inference-hosted. Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-4721

incident-bot: Incident created. Severity: P1. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/queue-backlog. Initial triage channel: #eng-oncall.

Ana: ack — Ana (oncall) taking initial triage. Pinging @James H @Mike. Noting spike started ~2026-03-17T10:45Z.

James H: quick look: autoscaler controller throwing rate-limit errors to cloud provider, looks like scale requests are being throttled. Logs:```
scale_controller.go:421 requestScale: cloudAPI: 429 Too Many Requests
scale_controller.go:439 lastScaleSucceededAt=2026-03-17T10:34:02Z
```

Sophie L: customer-impact: Support reports two paying customers getting 504s and degraded UX. Dashboards show 18% of requests queued >5s and error-rate bump on /v1/generate. Noting ticket #SUP-881 open.

Mike: I can do a manual pool spin-up and route high-priority traffic to a dedicated surge pool, but cloud quota might block more nodes. Recommend also throttling client concurrency at the edge to buy time.

Ana: running manual surge now — applying surge pool manifest and adding annotation to bypass autoscaler for these replicas. Posting output shortly.

Ana: ```kubectl scale deployment/surge-pool --replicas=6 --namespace=inference-prod```
Ana: output: deployment.apps/surge-pool scaled to 6 replicas :thumbsup:

James H: extra context — I see a retry-loop from a partner integration. They started retrying on transient 5xxs which amplified traffic (fanout). That pushed request fan-in and the autoscaler requests hit cloud rate limits. Suggest we add dedupe/circuit at router and ask partner to stop retries.

Sophie L: Support message to partner sent; partner acknowledged and will pause retries for 10m. Noted in SUP-881.

Mike: applied temporary per-IP concurrency limit at the edge: 50 concurrent per IP, and enabled aggressive KV cache reuse for hot prefixes. Also opened provider quota case (#Q-993) requesting immediate increase.

incident-bot: PagerDuty escalated to second-level oncall (James H) due to >15m without full recovery. Escalation time: 2026-03-17T10:58Z.

Ana: handing off live mitigation to Mike in 10m. Handoff notes: manual surge pool added, partner paused retries, per-IP limit applied. I'll remain available for coordination.

Mike: taking over. I'll keep PD acknowledged and watch queue depth for 15m windows. Plan: if queue depth stays >70% we'll route heavy customers to dedicated instances and continue provider follow-up.

James H: monitoring update — after manual scale + partner pause, queue depth dropped from 98% -> 62% in ~7 minutes. 95p latency improving on most routes.

Sophie L: customer update: Customers A and B reporting improved response times, Support keeping tickets open for 30m to validate.

incident-bot: Status changed to Mitigated — continuing to monitor. PD-4721 remains acknowledged. Runbook reminder: capture partner retries, autoscaler telemetry, and quota responses.

Ana: short-term actions covered. Follow-ups: (1) harden autoscaler backoff/retry behavior, (2) add automated partner rate-limits and dedupe at router, (3) add a one-click surge-pool spinup to runbook. I'll create follow-up tickets and schedule a post-incident sync. Thanks all. :heart:
